assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need to correlate clinical events with arrhythmic activity.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (MCT) is used to capture rhythm data during daily activities.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded with CPT 93229.
The claim supports diagnosis code R55.
The claim supports diagnosis code I48.0.
The claim supports diagnosis code I48.91.
